title: Vihusishi (Theme 1: Usafi wa mazingira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child chooses the relating word by what it relates: place (juu ya, chini ya, kando ya, ndani ya) or time (kabla ya, baada ya, tangu, hadi).
contexts: environmental cleanliness: taka ndani ya mto

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "kabla ya" and one sentence of place.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kihusishi kipi cha mahali?" Kwa nini "baada ya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mbele ya ni kihusishi cha mahali.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kihusishi kipi cha wakati?" Kwa nini "karibu na" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kabla ya ni kihusishi cha wakati.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Kitabu kiko juu meza." si jibu sahihi?

misconceptions.repair: Kwa wakati tunatumia kabla ya, baada ya, tangu.
